_doc: Băng Tâm Các cast, world-depth pilot (schema.md). Tiers A and B written by hand; tier C to follow. Seat ids assume the R4 move to place 214.

people.gloss: Ngọc hồ is the jade vessel that holds the ice heart (Vương Xương Linh)
people.role: Head of Băng Tâm Các, Keeper of the Vessel
people.appearance: Tall, white-haired since her Kết Đan, with eyes the pale grey of lake ice; she wears the jade vessel at her belt and nothing else of colour.
people.backstory: Sở Ngọc Hồ was found as an infant in a herder's tent on the flank of Băng Bích Nhai, the only one alive after a night so cold the herders' fire froze; Tần Ngưng Sương (tan_ngung_suong) took her as the last disciple of her long life and named her for the vessel. She grew up inside the Pavilion and has never lived anywhere else. When Tần died in 1010 (C175) the Vessel passed over the senior disciple Cố Lăng Sương (co_lang_suong) to her, and she has never learned why. She rules by stillness: the youngest speaks first, she speaks last, and her verdicts are short. In 1090 she stood with Đỗ Tinh Hà (do_tinh_ha) and Thôi Khinh Hồng (thoi_khinh_hong) at the death of Mặc Huyết Sinh (C024), and in 1121 she made Hạng Dạ Bôi (hang_da_boi) kneel (C185). The year the Pivot refused her claim to Tinh Tủy Mạch (C195) she shut herself in the ice hall for a year and came out with her hair a shade whiter. She plays the qin alone at night, the same three pieces.
people.wants: To leave the Pavilion stronger than she found it, and to name an heir who will not need her.
people.secret: She knows the Jade Vessel Array is weakening and has not told the sect, because she does not know how to mend it without Tiết Hàn Mai, who is dying.

people.gloss: She who stands above the frost
people.role: Grand elder of Băng Tâm Các, in seclusion on Băng Bích Nhai since 1010
people.appearance: A small woman wrapped in a grey fur gone white with rime, who has not cut her hair in two hundred years and wears it bound around her like a cloak.
people.backstory: Cố Lăng Sương was born in an ice-cutters' hamlet under Băng Trụ Phong in 560 and came to the Pavilion at nine, the first child of Ngọc Hồ Sơn to pass the Frost Test after the move onto Hồ Thiên's ruin (N-bang_tam-01). She was Tần Ngưng Sương's (tan_ngung_suong) senior disciple for four hundred years and her right hand in the Array; every elder expected her to take the Vessel. Tần gave it to the girl Sở Ngọc Hồ (so_ngoc_ho) instead (C175), and the same winter Cố climbed Băng Bích Nhai and closed the cave behind her (N-bang_tam-04). The sect has told itself the story of her bitterness for 190 years. The truth is the founder's last order: watch the fire from above, where the Array's threads meet the sky, and come down only when it wakes. For twenty years she has felt Chúc Long Sơn stir (A111). She has not come down, because she is not sure, and because coming down means admitting she was never bitter at all.
people.wants: To keep the founder's last order, and to be sure before she breaks her silence.
people.secret: She was never passed over: Tần chose her for the watch and Sở for the hall, and told neither the other's task.

ties.note: her master of four hundred years
the junior sister the sect thinks she hates

people.role: Master of the Hall of Cold Law; voice of the frost coast in the Pavilion
people.appearance: Broad, weathered and loud for a Băng Tâm elder, with a fisher's hands and a laugh that the seat's halls are not built for.
people.backstory: Thẩm Hàn Giang was born in Liên Giang Thành in 900 to ice-fishers who had paid their tax in fish since the Frost Coast fell (A131), and grew up cutting holes in the river ice beside the old men who still sat cultivating there in Hàn Giang's way. He passed the Frost Test at fourteen and rose through the Hall of Cold Law, which judges the frost-coast towns, until he ran it. He reached Nguyên Anh in 1180, the first frost-coast man to do so in the Pavilion's history. He laughs in council, which no one else does, and the coast loves him for it; his sworn brother Đoàn Thanh Lãng (doan_thanh_lang) heads Trạc Anh Đài. He wants the Vessel. He believes, honestly, that the Pavilion has spent seven hundred years ruling the coast without ever belonging to it, and that a coast-born Keeper would end the quiet contempt of the ice-born for everyone else. His disciple Liễu Ngư Ca (lieu_ngu_ca) is closer to that cause than even Thẩm knows.
people.wants: To be named heir, to make the frost coast the Pavilion's equal rather than its tax, and to rule at Hòe Âm this autumn for the men's lodge of the massif, whose men would then stand behind him.
people.secret: He has quietly kept the frost-coast towns' tax books in two sets for forty years: one for the seat, one that shows what the coast really pays.

people.role: First elder of Băng Tâm Các and keeper of the Jade Vessel Array (age 440)
people.appearance: Thin and stooped now, her hands always cold, a frost-silk sash knotted the old way; she smells of the pine tea she brews for the grand elder.
people.backstory: Tiết Hàn Mai came from the locust-shaded village of Hòe Âm (A102) and was the last disciple Tần Ngưng Sương (tan_ngung_suong) trained in the Array itself. In 820 she and Cố Lăng Sương (co_lang_suong) laid the Array's last nodes, sixty years after the Ice Soul vein was opened (A106), and she has kept it every year since, walking its 108 nodes under the seat by touch each winter. She is honest to the point of rudeness and cautious to the point of paralysis, and she has never taught the Array whole to anyone, because no one has been careful enough. She is 440, sixty years from the end of a Kết Đan life, and she knows that the Array will outlive her only if she reaches Nguyên Anh or finds an heir. She holds the Clear-Heart Mirror of the Regalia and has never offered it to Sở Ngọc Hồ (so_ngoc_ho), who has never asked. Every month she sends pine tea up Băng Bích Nhai. It is the only thing that goes up.
people.wants: Time: a Nguyên Anh breakthrough, or a disciple careful enough to hold the Array after her.
people.secret: She has felt three of the Array's nodes go warm since 1199 and has told only the grand elder.

people.gloss: Hidden fragrance (the plum's scent in the dark)
people.role: Master of the Plum Sword Hall; the last of Lãnh Hương Các (age 480)
people.appearance: A lean old swordsman with a plum-blossom scar on his left hand where his father's cape-pin burned him in the fire of Cô Thành.
people.backstory: Phó Ám Hương was four when his father Phó Thanh Mai (pho_thanh_mai) and every plum-blossom swordsman of Lãnh Hương Các rode out to break Phượng Minh's siege of Cô Thành and died (V071). A Băng Tâm soldier carried the boy out of the ruin wrapped in his father's cape, with the red-ink manual of the Snow Plum Sword sewn into the lining (N-bang_tam-03). The Pavilion raised him, and he gave it the sword: the inner gate learns it from him, in red ink only. He holds the white sword of the Plum pair; the red was lost at Cô Thành, and he believes Phượng Minh Cung took it. He writes a poem every year on the day the fortress fell. He is 480. He will not reach Nguyên Anh without the breakthrough pill the sect can buy once a generation, and so will Tiết Hàn Mai (tiet_han_mai), his friend of four centuries. He has decided, without telling anyone, that he will not ask for it until he has the red sword back.
people.wants: The red plum sword back from Phượng Minh before he dies; a disciple worthy of the pair.
people.secret: He has written to Phượng Minh's head Hoa Triêu Dương (hoa_trieu_duong) three times offering a duel for the sword, and has never sent the letters.

people.gloss: Lapis glaze (lưu ly), clear and cold
people.role: The head's first disciple and the seat's heir candidate
people.appearance: Beautiful in the Pavilion's way, cold and exact, with a sword so clear it looks like a sliver of glazed glass.
people.backstory: Khương Lưu Ly was born inside the seat in 950 to two inner disciples, the first child of the Pavilion's own halls in a century, and was the head's first disciple from the day Sở Ngọc Hồ (so_ngoc_ho) took the Vessel. She has never known a teacher, a home or a cause other than the Pavilion. She is the most gifted Ice cultivator of her generation and has never failed at anything she tried, which makes her arrogant without her noticing. She took half of a single element and drove it to the bottom; the only thing in her root is Water and Ice. The seat's elders see in her the old Pavilion they love. She sees the frost-coast man Thẩm Hàn Giang (tham_han_giang) as a decent elder who has mistaken a tax quarrel for a Dao. She has waited 190 years for her master to name her and has begun, privately, to wonder whether her master's silence is a judgement on her.
people.wants: To be named heir, to know why she has not been, and to see Lê Hoa Am's gate upheld at Hòe Âm, because the seat will read a ruling against a women's vow as a ruling against the Keepers.
people.secret: Since the 1188 petition she has written to the Pivot's young disciples under a false name to learn what Doãn Ngọc Hành said of her master.

people.role: Keeper of the Desert Pavilion (the old seat): caravans, trade and desert recruits
people.appearance: Sun-browned, the only elder who smiles in public, with sand always in the folds of her white robe.
people.backstory: Born to a fish-pond trader at the oasis of Ngư Đàm Thôn (A115), Ôn Sa Ngọc is proof that the desert can grow ice: she passed the Frost Test on her third try. She runs the old seat as the Pavilion's door to the desert and the caravan road, keeps peace with Dạ Quang's escorts, and sends the Frost Test the oasis children nobody else would look for, among them Hồ Tiểu Đàm (ho_tieu_dam). The ice-born elders call her post an exile, and she has come to love it. She pays Dạ Quang's escorts by loads delivered, and while night-glow cups keep turning up at the caravan stops she will not send the hostage home.
people.wants: To keep the Desert Pavilion alive as the Pavilion's door to the desert, and to be buried in the sand, not the glacier.
people.secret: She is skimming a tenth of the caravan toll into sealed jars under her cellar floor, against the day the seat calls the old hall home. Phí Thanh Sa (phi_thanh_sa) keeps the books and has begun counting the jars.

people.role: Steward and warden of the Ice Soul vein, Băng Phách Mạch
people.appearance: A quiet man whose left arm twitches when storms come; the scar of a lightning lash runs from his shoulder to his wrist.
people.backstory: From Kê Minh Trấn, where the cock crows in winter dark (A129), Kha Tĩnh Ba has watched the Ice Soul vein for sixty years. The vein's qi is two-thirds thunder, poison to Ice, and it lashed him in his first year; he stayed. He knows that ice beasts gather when the vein runs hot, and that it ran hot the winter Thủ Tuyết Bảo fell (V068). He reports to Thẩm Hàn Giang (tham_han_giang), whom he admires, and to Lam Tuyết Điêu (lam_tuyet_dieu), whom he loves.
people.wants: To make the seat believe the vein is warming without being asked what he did to it.
people.secret: Each night he opens a vent-sluice on Băng Phách Mạch by a hand's width to bleed the heat, which the Array Hall forbids. Quan Lăng Ba (quan_lang_ba) logs the drop and has told no one.

people.role: Elder of the Beast Hall: the ice beasts and the sect's mounts
people.appearance: Wiry and wind-burned, a white sable usually draped across her shoulders, smelling of hide and snow.
people.backstory: Raised by wolf-hunters on Tuyết Lang Nguyên, Lam Tuyết Điêu came to the Pavilion with a sable kit inside her coat and a tundra wolf at her heel. She keeps the Beast Hall at Hàn Giao Chử, where the sect's ice beasts are bred and its mounts trained, and she is the first to know when the beasts grow restless. Lately they have been restless. Her Dao partner Kha Tĩnh Ba (kha_tinh_ba) says the vein is warming.
people.wants: To breed a white sable pair that will not flee the vein's heat.
people.secret: She has been feeding the oldest wolf from her own plate and telling the hall it died in spring; it sleeps in the lamp-room under Diêu Hàn Đàm's (dieu_han_dam) bed, and the two women have not spoken of it.

people.role: Envoy of Băng Tâm Các to the Pivot and the vassals
people.appearance: Neat, soft-spoken, ink on his cuff; he bows exactly as deep as each listener's rank and never deeper.
people.backstory: A Hồi Lan Thành merchant's son, Ngụy Thanh Hàn wrote the Pavilion's 1188 petition for Tinh Tủy Mạch (C195) and watched Doãn Ngọc Hành (doan_ngoc_hanh) refuse it in front of the seven sects. He has never forgiven himself, and since then he has collected records of the vein's boundary stones, an old surveyor's map and the Pivot's own land rolls. He means to bring a second claim the Pivot cannot refuse.
people.wants: A second claim to Tinh Tủy Mạch that the Pivot cannot refuse.
people.secret: He is paying a Pivot land clerk in Pavilion silver to copy the rolls, and his aide Vương Thanh Lẫm (vuong_thanh_lam) has begun selling copies of the copies to the treasurer Quách Lẫm (quach_lam). Over wine he also lets the Hall of Trust's courier Thư Ngạn Hành (thu_ngan_hanh) read him each letter before it is delivered, paying in northern pepper, and files whatever names Cô Thành for the day the Pivot needs a lever.

people.role: Guest alchemist of Băng Tâm Các (a Fire root in an Ice sect)
people.appearance: Red-cheeked and sweating even in the Pavilion's cold, the only man at Hàn Giao Chử who wears his robe open.
people.backstory: Trained at Hồng Lô Cốc, Thúy Vi's furnace vassal in the tundra, Viên Chước lost the valley's year of ash money at dice in 1144, and Đồng Hồng Lô (dong_hong_lo) sold his contract to Băng Tâm to cover it. He brews outside the seat at Hàn Giao Chử and charges like a pirate. Phó Ám Hương (pho_am_huong) will not eat a pill he makes. In 1199 the Keeper sent him south with the bill of his own sale, whose clause gives the Pavilion one boat of ash at the 1144 price in every ten years, and he reached the valley in the first month of the ash rain. Viên alone could brew the breakthrough pill both old elders need, and he knows it.
people.wants: To take a whole boat of ash at the 1144 price, and to win at the valley's dice what he lost there.
people.secret: He brings the Pavilion's ash purse to the snow-house table and has lost a fifth of it already.

people.role: The head's disciple, age 60
people.appearance: A grave young woman in undyed white who wears the winter robe her name means even in summer.
people.backstory: Sở Hàn Y was left in the snow at the ruin of Bắc Đình Thành as a baby, with a winter robe around her and no name, and was brought to the Vessel Hall; Sở Ngọc Hồ (so_ngoc_ho) gave her her own surname, which she has given no one else, and named her for the robe. She learned her first cut from Khương Lưu Ly (khuong_luu_ly) and her stillness from her master, whom she copies so closely the seat jokes there are two Keepers. She has nothing yet but an ice sword and the frost seal, and she is not in a hurry. She is the one person in the Pavilion who would follow her master into the volcano without asking why.
people.wants: To be worthy of the surname.
people.secret: For three winters she has followed the Keeper and Tiết Hàn Mai under the seat and learned eleven of the 108 nodes by touch, more than anyone alive but Tiết. Tiết hears her behind them and walks slower.

people.role: The head's second disciple, who hides a Darkness root
people.appearance: Small, pale, with black eyes that do not reflect the lamps; her frost leaves a faint grey stain where it melts.
people.backstory: Cung Mặc Sương grew up among the bitter wells of Hắc Ngạn Trấn after the ash fell (V080), stealing from the fishers who were left, and was taken into the outer gate at twelve for her Water. She passed the Frost Test in a single night, the fastest anyone remembered, and Sở Ngọc Hồ (so_ngoc_ho) took her as her second disciple. Her Ice is real. Under it is Darkness, Earth and Water converged, which she learned to hide before she learned to read. No Ice method feeds it, and it starves inside her. In 1196 a woman found her on the lake ice and offered her a method that would feed it. The woman was Triệu Huyết Y (trieu_huyet_y), the last disciple of the ma đạo master Cung's own master helped kill (C024). Cung has not said yes. She has not reported it either.
people.wants: To stop starving half of her root.
people.secret: The Darkness root, and Triệu Huyết Y's offer.

people.role: Thẩm Hàn Giang's disciple; the hidden heir of Hàn Giang Môn
people.appearance: A tall, easy young man who sings fishermen's songs under his breath, badly, and sits on the lake ice the old Hàn Giang way.
people.backstory: Liễu Ngư Ca's family have fished the cold river at Liên Giang since the Frost Coast fell, and they have kept a secret for seven hundred years: they are the line of Liễu Cô Chu (lieu_co_chu), Hàn Giang Môn's last head, who died when the Pavilion took the coast (C099). His grandmother taught him the ice-hole sitting method of the fallen sect before he could swim, and told him where Liễu Thoa Lạp's (lieu_thoa_lap) lone fisher's rod was lost in the ruin of Hàn Giang Môn. Thẩm Hàn Giang (tham_han_giang) took him as a disciple without knowing any of it. Liễu loves his master, the lake, and the Pavilion's songless halls, and he does not know what he would do if the frost coast rose and asked for him.
people.wants: To find the Lone Fisher's Rod; to never have to choose between his master and his blood.
people.secret: His blood, and the ice-hole method.

people.role: Founder of Băng Tâm Các (year 440, at 140); lies inside the Jade Vessel Array under the seat
people.appearance: Remembered as a slight scholar in southern grey, a jade vessel hung at her waist and ink on her wrist.
people.backstory: Tần Ngưng Sương came out of a scholar's family in the warm south carrying one line of poetry, a piece of ice in a jade vessel, and a method she had written to keep a heart that clear. She crossed the desert in 440 and founded the Pavilion at its edge, facing ice she could not yet take (C007), and made the desert well run cold (A114). In 470 she claimed the empty ice of Ngọc Hồ Sơn (C095), moved the sect onto the ruin of Hồ Thiên Phái (N-bang_tam-01) and laid the Jade Vessel Array over the vent that had buried it (N-bang_tam-02). She won the Frost Coast (C099) and lost the Desert Road (C143), and she ruled 570 years. At the end she gave the hall to Sở Ngọc Hồ (so_ngoc_ho) and the watch to Cố Lăng Sương (co_lang_suong), told neither, and had herself laid inside the Array, which some say she still keeps.
